versions.changelog: 默认返回最终采集结果，完善异步等待下载与安全恢复；修复空目标误执行、Quick Start、Token 配置和触发路由冲突，并补齐发布前自动化测试
新增能力路由与异步任务闭环，修复失效引用、Token 泄漏和 Skill 元数据兼容性
补全中文文档，更新目录结构

Initial release of dataify-bing-videos skill.

- Converts natural-language Bing video search requests into Dataify Bing Videos API parameters.
- Displays a full parameter confirmation table to the user before making any live API call.
- Allows users to review and modify parameters prior to execution.
- Handles authentication via the DATAIFY_API_TOKEN environment variable or user input.
- Returns API responses directly without additional summarization or formatting.
